what.text: This page follows refugees from Sri Lanka living in Australia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3215 Sri Lankan refugees in Australia, 2.2% of all refugees from Sri Lanka.
India hosts the most Sri Lankan refugees, followed by France, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Eelam territory in Sri Lanka with the LTTE in periods from 1991 to 2009, at war level in most of those years.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2011 to 2022 and 2024 to 2025, come after that conflict ended.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 1177 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 4787, at the end of 2018, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Australia.
These are year-end totals for Australia only, reported to UNHCR.
